data, and AI meet.

I’m a Computer Science (AI) undergraduate at Manipal Institute of Technology, MAHE, Bengaluru. I build full-stack applications and explore how AI assistants can work inside them.

My projects connect interfaces, APIs, relational databases, and AI tools. During my internship at UZIO, I also worked on an HRIS and payroll platform and contributed to an internal chatbot prototype.
